# Test fixtures

Same layout as `data/raw/`; the tests copy this tree into a temporary data directory and
run the full ingest on it.

| Path | What | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `bundestag/protocols/21/21094.xml` | Plenarprotokoll 21/94, **excerpt**: two agenda items, three `rede` elements (one with a Zwischenfrage). Marked as excerpt in an XML comment. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21094.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `decisions/21090.xml` | Plenarprotokoll 21/90, **excerpt** for the decision parser: agenda items ZP 28, 29 and TOP 25 without their speeches and without the roll-call name lists. Outside the raw layout so the main ingest tests keep their counts; `test_parse_decisions.py` copies it in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21090.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `sub_items/21096.xml`, `sub_items/21050.xml` | Plenarprotokoll 21/96 and 21/50, **excerpts** for the sub-item tests: 21/96 TOP 41 (18 items 41b–41s voted without debate, one speech) and TOP 8 (a debated pair, speeches removed); 21/50 TOP 37 (Portugal request, Sammelübersichten 117–142, Zusatzpunkte 10a–10o) and TOP 22 (a debated triple, speeches removed). Outside the raw layout; `test_sub_items.py` copies them in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21096.xml, …/21050.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `question_turns/21006.xml`, `question_turns/21082.xml` | Plenarprotokoll 21/6 and 21/82, **excerpts** for the question-turn tests: the Befragung der Bundesregierung (TOP 1), 21/6 from the start to the answer to the fifth Hauptfrage, 21/82 its opening remarks and the redes from Büdenbender's Hauptfrage to the answer to Kersten; every rede keeps its speaker lines, each speaker's first paragraph and all presidency remarks. Outside the raw layout; `test_question_turns.py` parses them and copies 21/6 in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21006.xml, …/21082.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `question_texts/21052.xml`, `question_texts/21053.xml` | Plenarprotokoll 21/52 and 21/53, **excerpts** for the question-text tests: 21/52 its Fragestunde (TOP 2) up to the call of Frage 3, and from its annex of written answers the entries for Fragen 30 (not answered), 31, 32 and 33 (answer missed the deadline) and 45 (with a table); 21/53 only its annex entry with the joint answer to Fragen 32 and 33. Outside the raw layout; `test_question_texts.py` parses them and copies them in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21052.xml, …/21053.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `answers/2103326.pdf`, `answers/2101343.pdf`, `answers/2100669.pdf` | The answers of the Bundesregierung to the Kleinen Anfragen 21/2852, 21/1026 and 21/439 (Drucksachen 21/3326, 21/1343, 21/669), **unchanged**: sub-questions answered one by one; a joint answer and a question misprinted in the answer's type; tables and an annex of tables without ruling. Outside the raw layout; `test_answers.py` parses copies and copies 21/1343 in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btd/21/033/2103326.pdf, …/013/2101343.pdf, …/006/2100669.pdf, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `schriftliche/2102290.pdf` | The Sammeldrucksache 21/2290, Schriftliche Fragen with the answers received in the week of 13 October 2025, **unchanged** (81 questions, joint answers, tables). Outside the raw layout; `test_schriftliche.py` parses a copy and copies it in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btd/21/022/2102290.pdf, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `preliminary/21031.xml`, `preliminary/21031.pdf`, `preliminary/21049.xml` | The preliminary Plenarprotokoll 21/31 as served on 2026-10-01, **excerpt**: its last agenda item (TOP 22) with the note that the final report follows; four pages of the final PDF, **extracted unchanged** (3371, where the XML ends; 3392–3393, TOP 29; 3404, the end of the sitting); 21/49 **excerpt**: one speaker line of Kerstin Griese. Outside the raw layout; `test_protocol_gaps.py` copies them in. | https://dserver.bundestag.de/btp/21/21031.xml, …/21031.pdf, …/21049.xml, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `bundestag/stammdaten/MDB_STAMMDATEN.XML` | **Excerpt**: 11 MDB records (incl. two Beckers and historical namesakes) | https://www.bundestag.de/resource/blob/472878/MdB-Stammdaten.zip, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `bundestag/votes/20260710_7-xls.xlsx` | Roll-call vote 21/90/7 (Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz), **unchanged** | https://www.bundestag.de/resource/blob/1194636/20260710_7-xls.xlsx, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `bundestag/votes/index.json` | the list row for that vote | bundestag.de vote list |
| `abgeordnetenwatch/wp21-*.json` | 8 real politician / mandate records; `wp21-sidejobs.json`: 6 real side jobs of four of them (recorded 2026-09-28) | abgeordnetenwatch.de API v2, CC0 1.0 |
| `bundeswahlleiterin/btw25/*.csv` | **Excerpts**: 9 rows of the elected candidates (the fixture MdBs, plus two namesakes who are not in the fixture Stammdaten) and all rows of Wahlkreise 14, 114 and 297 from `kerg2.csv`; preamble and header unchanged | https://www.bundeswahlleiterin.de/bundestagswahlen/2025/ergebnisse/opendata.html, © Die Bundeswahlleiterin, Wiesbaden 2025, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0 |
| `bundeswahlleiterin/btw25/btw25_nachfolger.pdf` | **Unchanged** (one page, 9 successions, as served on 2026-10-04, last modified 2026-06-23) | https://www.bundeswahlleiterin.de/bundestagswahlen/2025/gewaehlte.html, © Die Bundeswahlleiterin, Wiesbaden; reuse with source as in docs/licences.md |
| `dip/**` | Recorded responses (2026-09-27), **trimmed**: 4 Drucksachen of 6–10 July 2026 — 21/6977 (Entschließungsantrag, Die Linke), 21/7107 (Beschlussempfehlung with Berichterstattung activities), 21/7052 (Schriftliche Fragen: 3 of 148 askers, 3 of 230 Vorgänge; `autoren_anzahl` is 0), 21/7009 (Beschlussempfehlung behind roll-call vote 21/90/7) — with their activities (for 21/7052 also the answers to two of the three questions) and Vorgänge; the Aktivitäten of Plenarprotokoll 21/9 (DIP id 5713, retrieved 2026-10-04), **trimmed** to two Mündliche Fragen (Frage, Zusatzfrage, Antwort), one Befragung question and one speech; the one Vorgangsposition with the vote's Namentliche Abstimmung plus one other; the 13 WP21 persons matching the fixture Stammdaten or a Staatssekretär. | DIP API, Deutscher Bundestag/Bundesrat – DIP |
| `bundestag/biografien/page-000.html` | **Excerpt**: 7 of 639 cards of the MdB biography list, each card unchanged (six fixture MdBs, and Sanae Abdi, who is not in the fixture Stammdaten) | https://www.bundestag.de/ajax/filterlist/de/abgeordnete/1040594-1040594, Deutscher Bundestag |
| `bundestag/fotos/*.jpg` | Two portraits from those cards, **unchanged** (Bärbel Bas, Pascal Meiser); credits as on the cards | bundestag.de; rights of the named photographers |
| `wikidata/government.json` | Recorded SPARQL response (2026-09-28), **trimmed** to the rows of Merz, Bas, Hubig and Warken (two roles) | query.wikidata.org, CC0 1.0 |
| `wikidata/commons.json`, `wikidata/fotos/*.jpg` | Commons imageinfo of their P18 images, and one 864 px thumbnail (Stefanie Hubig) | Wikimedia Commons; photo by Sandro Halank, CC BY-SA 4.0 |

Every raw file has a `.meta.json` sidecar with `url` and `retrieved_at`, as `bdf fetch` writes it.
